evidenceDetails.analysisEngine: Deterministic structural validation script (synthesize_sa3.cjs / schema checks)
evidenceDetails.natureOfVerification: Structural assertion verification ensuring that candidate object fields (appliesWhen, doesNotApplyWhen, scope, modality) explicitly capture preconditions and negative constraints without dropping fields present in the source rule metadata.
evidenceDetails.semanticLimit: The algorithm does not execute semantic parsing or proof-theoretic entailment checking. It evaluates structured field mappings and verifies that no source constraints were left unmapped.

calibrationRecommendation: Do not label deterministic structural field checking as deep semantic theorem proving. Accurately designate it as STRUCTURAL_FIELD_COMPARISON.
